report.overall: WETH9 implements a minimal wrapped Ether contract with deposit, withdraw, and ERC20-like functions using direct balance updates and msg.sender.transfer. No High or Medium Slither findings are present, and the code follows check-effects-interactions in withdraw while emitting all relevant events. The contract is non-upgradeable and contains no oracle, signature, or pausing logic.

checklist.note: No owner or privileged roles defined in the contract; all functions are public.
No proxy, delegatecall, or upgrade mechanisms present in source.
withdraw updates balanceOf before msg.sender.transfer, following check-effects-interactions.
No oracle or price feed usage in the provided code.
Uses direct += and -= on balances; Slither reports no High/Medium arithmetic issues.
Only call is msg.sender.transfer(wad) after state update in withdraw.
No signature verification or replay protection logic in source.
No pause, stop, or emergency functions defined.
approve and transferFrom implement standard allowance logic with uint(-1) infinite check.
Deposit, Withdrawal, Approval, and Transfer events are emitted on all state changes.

slither_triage.why: Three informational findings expected for legacy 0.4.18 patterns such as pragma and naming; no impact on security.
Three optimization findings likely relate to storage or gas patterns in minimal WETH implementation; accepted for this contract.

report.overall: TetherToken implements a deprecated ERC20 variant without return values on transfer/approve plus upgrade, pause, blacklist and fee logic on 0.4.17. All 15 Slither Medium findings stem from the same interface mismatch; no High-severity issues were reported. The design intentionally deviates from modern ERC20 to preserve legacy behavior and add administrative controls.

checklist.note: Ownable with onlyOwner on issue/redeem/deprecate/pause/blacklist; transferOwnership lacks zero-address check after initial assignment.
Deprecated flag forwards calls to arbitrary upgradedAddress; no access control on the proxy target itself.
No external calls inside state-changing functions; only internal balance updates and events.
No oracles or price feeds present in the contract.
SafeMath used for all arithmetic; onlyPayloadSize modifier present on critical paths.
Calls to UpgradedStandardToken when deprecated; target address is fully trusted but not validated.
No signatures or EIP-712 logic implemented.
Pausable with whenNotPaused on transfers; owner-only pause/unpause.

All state changes emit Transfer/Approval/Issue/Redeem/Deprecate/Params events.

slither_triage.why: Tether deliberately implements the pre-2018 ERC20 without bool returns and adds fee/blacklist logic; the reported mismatches are expected and not vulnerabilities.

report.overall: FiatTokenV2_2 inherits from FiatTokenV2_1 and implements initializeV2_2 (requiring _initializedVersion==2, migrating _deprecatedBlacklisted accounts, setting symbol and _initializedVersion=3) plus overrides for _chainId (with assembly), _domainSeparator, permit/transferWithAuthorization variants, _setBlacklistState/_setBalance/_isBlacklisted/_balanceOf (using balanceAndBlacklistStates bit ops), and approve/increaseAllowance etc. (all gated by whenNotPaused/notBlacklisted). Slither reports 0 high/medium findings (9 low, 35 informational).

checklist.note: initializeV2_2, permit, transferWithAuthorization, receiveWithAuthorization, cancelAuthorization, approve, increaseAllowance, decreaseAllowance all enforce whenNotPaused and/or notBlacklisted modifiers from parent contracts.
initializeV2_2 checks require(_initializedVersion == 2) then sets _initializedVersion = 3 after blacklist migration and symbol update.
No external calls visible in FiatTokenV2_2.sol; all state changes occur before or without reentrant paths.
No oracle or price feeds present in the provided FiatTokenV2_2 source.
_setBalance enforces _balance <= ((1 << 255) - 1) and uses SafeMath from imported OpenZeppelin; bit operations on balanceAndBlacklistStates are explicit.
No external calls or delegatecalls appear in FiatTokenV2_2.sol functions.
permit, transferWithAuthorization, receiveWithAuthorization, cancelAuthorization forward to _permit/_transferWithAuthorization etc. with deadline, validAfter/validBefore, nonce checks (inherited).
All public mutative functions (permit, transferWithAuthorization, approve, etc.) include whenNotPaused modifier.
approve, increaseAllowance, decreaseAllowance override to call _approve/_increaseAllowance/_decreaseAllowance under whenNotPaused.
No new events defined; relies on parent FiatTokenV1/V2 events for Transfer/Approval/Blacklist changes.

slither_triage.why: Explicit assembly { chainId := chainid() } matches the documented _chainId override for EIP712 domain separator.
_setBlacklistState, _setBalance, _isBlacklisted, _balanceOf intentionally pack blacklist flag in high bit and balance in lower 255 bits as shown in source.

report.overall: UniswapV2Factory.sol deploys immutable UniswapV2Pair contracts via create2 and exposes only feeTo/feeToSetter setters guarded by feeToSetter. The Pair contract uses a reentrancy lock, SafeMath, and explicit balance checks after external transfers. Slither reports one High (timestamp truncation) and five Medium issues, all of which match patterns that are either intentional or mitigated by existing guards in the supplied source.

checklist.note: setFeeTo and setFeeToSetter require msg.sender == feeToSetter; initialize requires msg.sender == factory; createPair enforces token ordering and non-existence.
No proxy, delegatecall, or upgrade logic present in UniswapV2Factory or UniswapV2Pair.
UniswapV2Pair.lock modifier sets unlocked=0 before external calls and restores it after; all state writes after _safeTransfer occur under the lock.
price0CumulativeLast and price1CumulativeLast updated only inside _update using UQ112x112 arithmetic on reserves.
SafeMath.add/sub/mul used throughout; _update explicitly checks balance0/balance1 <= uint112(-1).
_safeTransfer performs raw token.call and requires success plus optional bool decode; swap and burn call IUniswapV2Callee after transfers.
permit uses nonces[owner]++ and EIP-712 DOMAIN_SEPARATOR with chainId; deadline check present.
No pause or emergency-stop mechanism defined in the source.
transferFrom subtracts from allowance only when allowance != uint(-1); _approve emits Approval.
PairCreated, Mint, Burn, Swap, Sync, Approval, Transfer all emitted with indexed parameters as declared.

slither_triage.why: _update casts block.timestamp % 2**32 into blockTimestampLast solely for timeElapsed calculation in TWAP accumulators; overflow is explicitly desired per comment.

_safeTransfer requires success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data,(bool))) to support both compliant and non-compliant ERC20 returns; _totalSupply == 0 branch mints MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY exactly once.
All three reported functions (swap, burn, createPair) execute external calls only while the lock modifier holds unlocked==0; state writes after calls are protected.

report.overall: UniswapV2Router02.sol implements permissionless liquidity and swap routing with immutable factory/WETH addresses and deadline checks via the ensure modifier. Slither reports three High findings on reentrancy-balance in the fee-on-transfer swap paths and one unchecked transfer in removeLiquidity, plus six Medium unused-return issues. The provided source contains no access-control logic, no upgrade paths, no pause mechanisms, and no events beyond those inherited from interfaces.

checklist.note: No owner, admin, or role checks exist in the contract; all external functions are callable by any address.
Constructor sets immutable factory and WETH; no proxy or delegatecall patterns are present.

Slither flags reentrancy-balance in swapExactTokensForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens and swapExactETHForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens via _swapSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens calling pair.swap before the final balance check.
All amounts are computed via UniswapV2Library.getAmountsOut/In using on-chain pair reserves; no external price oracles are called.
SafeMath is used for all uint operations; no unchecked arithmetic blocks appear in the source.
Multiple external calls to pairs, factory, tokens, and WETH occur; Slither notes unchecked return from IUniswapV2Pair.transferFrom in removeLiquidity at line 328.
Permit functions forward EIP-2612 signatures directly to the pair; no additional signature handling or replay protection is implemented in the router.
No pause, circuit-breaker, or emergency withdrawal functions are defined.
removeLiquidityWithPermit and removeLiquidityETHWithPermit call pair.permit before transferFrom; all other transfers use TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom.
No events are emitted by the router itself; only interface-defined events from pairs and tokens can fire.

slither_triage.why: The two High findings match the balanceBefore read before _swapSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens and the subsequent require on balanceOf in the fee-on-transfer swap functions at lines 554 and 571.
The ignored return of transferFrom at line 328 in removeLiquidity is followed by an immediate burn call that reverts on failure, matching the pattern used elsewhere with TransferHelper.
All six Medium findings are calls to sortTokens or getReserves that deliberately ignore the third return value (blockTimestampLast or the second token); the source never assigns it.

report.overall: SwapRouter (contracts/SwapRouter.sol) is a stateless router relying on PeripheryPaymentsWithFee, Multicall, SelfPermit and PeripheryValidation; it performs no access-control checks beyond msg.sender payer semantics and uses delegatecall in multicall. No upgradeability, pausing, oracles or events are present in the provided code. High-impact Slither findings map to inherited pay/transferFrom patterns and the Multicall loop, all of which are intentional design choices visible in the source.

checklist.note: No owner or role checks; payer is always msg.sender or address(this) after first hop (exactInput, exactOutputInternal).
Constructor sets immutable factory and WETH9; no proxy or delegate patterns beyond Multicall.
Swaps call pool.swap then pay; no reentrant state writes after external calls in SwapRouter or Multicall.
No price or oracle reads; sqrtPriceLimitX96 is caller-supplied parameter only.
Uses SafeCast and explicit checks (amountOut >= minimum, amountIn <= maximum); no FullMath in this file.
pool.swap, pay (transferFrom/WETH), and delegatecall in Multicall; arbitrary payer passed to pay from callback data.
SelfPermit calls IERC20Permit.permit with msg.sender as owner; deadline and nonce handling left to token.
No pause flag or emergency functions in SwapRouter or inherited contracts shown.
pay uses safeTransferFrom with arbitrary payer from SwapCallbackData; relies on prior approval or selfPermit.
No events emitted in any function of SwapRouter.sol or Multicall.sol.

slither_triage.why: pay(token,payer,recipient,value) intentionally forwards payer from SwapCallbackData; caller must have approved or used selfPermit.
Multicall.multicall explicitly loops over delegatecall to self for batched user calls; documented in IMulticall.
IWETH9.transfer and ERC20.transferFrom results are ignored only in base PeripheryPayments; SwapRouter never calls these paths directly.
FullMath is imported only via @uniswap/v3-core; not present or used in SwapRouter.sol or listed base files.
